corrections.text: The article quotes The Register describing Red Hat's shift as moderating its 'previously enthusiastic AI stance.' The Register's original wording is 'previously gung-ho AI stance' — the word was altered while still presented inside quotation marks.

The article attributes the cited Gartner spending-tier statistics to 'The Register.' In the source, The Register reports that DevOps.com cited this Gartner research, not The Register directly. The article also describes the Reddit developer spending figures ($1,000 to several thousand a month) as coming from 'the same report' as the Gartner statistics; in the source these are a separate, unrelated observation by The Register, not part of the Gartner-sourced citation.
